source_title: Day after Spain train accident, rescuers search crash site for survivors
source_excerpt: URDA, Spain Rescuers searched desperately through wrecked ⁠carriages on Thursday (October 29, 2026) in the hope of finding more survivors of Spain’s second deadly high-speed train crash this year, which has so far claimed 68 lives.
